statement: WITH base AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_channel_labels_20260612 WHERE topic_category_count > 0), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_nonempty_channels FROM base), parent_roles AS (SELECT topic_category AS parent_label, empirical_role FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_label_roles_20260612 WHERE empirical_role IN ('empirical_parent', 'intermediate_or_crosscutting_parent')), parent_presence AS (SELECT b.channel_id, r.parent_label, r.empirical_role FROM base b INNER JOIN parent_roles r ON array_contains(b.topic_categories, r.parent_label)), parent_counts AS (SELECT p.parent_label, p.empirical_role, COUNT(DISTINCT p.channel_id) AS n_parent_channels, MAX(t.n_nonempty_channels) AS n_nonempty_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT p.channel_id) / MAX(t.n_nonempty_channels) AS parent_prevalence FROM parent_presence p CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY p.parent_label, p.empirical_role), qualified AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY parent_prevalence DESC, parent_label) AS prevalence_rank FROM parent_counts WHERE parent_prevalence > 0.02), parent_pairs AS (SELECT a.channel_id, a.parent_label AS parent_a, b.parent_label AS parent_b FROM parent_presence a INNER JOIN parent_presence b ON a.channel_id = b.channel_id), pair_counts AS (SELECT qa.parent_label AS parent_a, qb.parent_label AS parent_b, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.channel_id) AS n_both_channels FROM qualified qa CROSS JOIN qualified qb LEFT JOIN parent_pairs pp ON qa.parent_label = pp.parent_a AND qb.parent_label = pp.parent_b GROUP BY qa.parent_label, qb.parent_label) SELECT qa.prevalence_rank AS row_rank, qb.prevalence_rank AS col_rank, qa.parent_label AS parent_a, qb.parent_label AS parent_b, qa.empirical_role AS empirical_role_a, qb.empirical_role AS empirical_role_b, qa.n_nonempty_channels, qa.n_parent_channels AS n_parent_a_channels, qb.n_parent_channels AS n_parent_b_channels, pc.n_both_channels, qa.parent_prevalence AS prevalence_a, qb.parent_prevalence AS prevalence_b, pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_nonempty_channels AS joint_prevalence, pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_parent_channels AS conditional_b_given_a, pc.n_both_channels / qb.n_parent_channels AS conditional_a_given_b, pc.n_both_channels / (qa.n_parent_channels + qb.n_parent_channels - pc.n_both_channels) AS jaccard, (pc.n_both_channels / qa.n_nonempty_channels) / NULLIF(qa.parent_prevalence * qb.parent_prevalence, 0) AS lift_vs_independence FROM qualified qa CROSS JOIN qualified qb INNER JOIN pair_counts pc ON qa.parent_label = pc.parent_a AND qb.parent_label = pc.parent_b ORDER BY qa.prevalence_rank, qb.prevalence_rank
